record.bible_text: Israel<WH03478> <FI>is<Fi> an empty<WH01238><WTH8802> vine<WH01612>, he bringeth forth<WH07737><WTH8762> fruit<WH06529> unto himself: according to the multitude<WH07230> of his fruit<WH06529> he hath increased<WH07235><WTH8689> the altars<WH04196>; according to the goodness<WH02896> of his land<WH0776> they have made goodly<WH02895><WTH8689> images<WH04676>. <RF>an...: or, a vine emptying the fruit which it giveth<Rf> <RF>images: Heb. statues, or, standing images<Rf>

Their heart<WH03820> is divided<WH02505><WTH8804>; now shall they be found faulty<WH0816><WTH8799>: he shall break down<WH06202><WTH8799> their altars<WH04196>, he shall spoil<WH07703><WTH8779> their images<WH04676>. <RF>Their heart...: or, He hath divided their heart<Rf> <RF>break...: Heb. behead<Rf> <RF>images: Heb. statues, or, standing images<Rf>
For now they shall say<WH0559><WTH8799>, We have no king<WH04428>, because we feared<WH03372><WTH8804> not the LORD<WH03068>; what then should a king<WH04428> do<WH06213><WTH8799> to us?

They have spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> words<WH01697>, swearing<WH0422><WTH8800> falsely<WH07723> in making<WH03772><WTH8800> a covenant<WH01285>: thus judgment<WH04941> springeth up<WH06524><WTH8804> as hemlock<WH07219> in the furrows<WH08525> of the field<WH07704>.

The inhabitants<WH07934> of Samaria<WH08111> shall fear<WH01481><WTH8799> because of the calves<WH05697> of Bethaven<WH01007>: for the people<WH05971> thereof shall mourn<WH056><WTH8804> over it, and the priests<WH03649> thereof <FI>that<Fi> rejoiced<WH01523><WTH8799> on it, for the glory<WH03519> thereof, because it is departed<WH01540><WTH8804> from it. <RF>the priests...: or, Chemarim<Rf>

It shall be also carried<WH02986><WTH8714> unto Assyria<WH0804> <FI>for<Fi> a present<WH04503> to king<WH04428> Jareb<WH03377>: Ephraim<WH0669> shall receive<WH03947><WTH8799> shame<WH01317>, and Israel<WH03478> shall be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8799> of his own counsel<WH06098>.
<FI> As for<Fi> Samaria<WH08111>, her king<WH04428> is cut off<WH01820><WTH8738> as the foam<WH07110> upon<WH06440> the water<WH04325>. <RF>the water: Heb. the face of the water<Rf>

The high places<WH01116> also of Aven<WH0206>, the sin<WH02403> of Israel<WH03478>, shall be destroyed<WH08045><WTH8738>: the thorn<WH06975> and the thistle<WH01863> shall come up<WH05927><WTH8799> on their altars<WH04196>; and they shall say<WH0559><WTH8804> to the mountains<WH02022>, Cover<WH03680><WTH8761> us; and to the hills<WH01389>, Fall<WH05307><WTH8798> on us.<CM>

O Israel<WH03478>, thou hast sinned<WH02398><WTH8804> from the days<WH03117> of Gibeah<WH01390>: there they stood<WH05975><WTH8804>: the battle<WH04421> in Gibeah<WH01390> against the children<WH01121> of iniquity<WH05932> did not overtake<WH05381><WTH8686> them.

<FI> It is<Fi> in my desire<WH0185> that I should chastise<WH03256><WTH8799> them; and the people<WH05971> shall be gathered<WH0622><WTH8795> against them, when they shall bind<WH0631><WTH8800> themselves in their two<WH08147> furrows<WH05869>. <RF>when...: or, when I shall bind them for their two transgressions, or, in their two habitations<Rf>

And Ephraim<WH0669> <FI>is as<Fi> an heifer<WH05697> <FI>that is<Fi> taught<WH03925><WTH8794>, <FI>and<Fi> loveth<WH0157><WTH8802> to tread out<WH01758><WTH8800> <FI>the corn<Fi> ; but I passed over<WH05674><WTH8804> upon her fair<WH02898> neck<WH06677>: I will make Ephraim<WH0669> to ride<WH07392><WTH8686>; Judah<WH03063> shall plow<WH02790><WTH8799>, <FI>and<Fi> Jacob<WH03290> shall break his clods<WH07702><WTH8762>. <RF>her...: Heb. the beauty of her neck<Rf>

Sow<WH02232><WTH8798> to yourselves in righteousness<WH06666>, reap<WH07114><WTH8798> in<WH06310> mercy<WH02617>; break up<WH05214><WTH8798> your fallow ground<WH05215>: for <FI>it is<Fi> time<WH06256> to seek<WH01875><WTH8800> the LORD<WH03068>, till he come<WH0935><WTH8799> and rain<WH03384><WTH8686> righteousness<WH06664> upon you.

Ye have plowed<WH02790><WTH8804> wickedness<WH07562>, ye have reaped<WH07114><WTH8804> iniquity<WH05766>; ye have eaten<WH0398><WTH8804> the fruit<WH06529> of lies<WH03585>: because thou didst trust<WH0982><WTH8804> in thy way<WH01870>, in the multitude<WH07230> of thy mighty men<WH01368>.

Therefore shall a tumult<WH07588> arise<WH06965><WTH8804> among thy people<WH05971>, and all thy fortresses<WH04013> shall be spoiled<WH07703><WTH8714>, as Shalman<WH08020> spoiled<WH07701> Betharbel<WH01009> in the day<WH03117> of battle<WH04421>: the mother<WH0517> was dashed in pieces<WH07376><WTH8795> upon <FI>her<Fi> children<WH01121>.

So<WH03602> shall Bethel<WH01008> do<WH06213><WTH8804> unto you because<WH06440> of your great<WH07451> wickedness<WH07451>: in a morning<WH07837> shall the king<WH04428> of Israel<WH03478> utterly<WH01820><WTH8736> be cut off<WH01820><WTH8738>. <RF>your...: Heb. the evil of your evil<Rf><CM>
